"It works" at prototype scale:
   Proven on 50 test questions, one user, one machine.

"It works" at production scale:
   Proven under real load, real failure, and real cost --
   for years.
caption: Scaling isn't the same system, just bigger -- new failure modes become possible.

eyebrow: Four dimensions that change at scale

steps.label: Load
steps.sub: A per-request cost or delay invisible at low volume dominates at real volume

steps.label: Failure Modes
steps.sub: Partial failure becomes a continuous condition, not a rare edge case

steps.label: Cost
steps.sub: Fractions of a cent per call become a board-level budget line

steps.label: Org Surface Area
steps.sub: One owner becomes many -- engineers, security, finance, support
